system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Checks whether the farmer/region is eligible for PM-PRANAM incentives. For your information, my land_parcel_id is dummy_land_parcel_id_4368, my aadhaar_number is 100020001328.

function.name: pmpranam_check_incentive_eligibility
function.description: Checks whether the farmer/region is eligible for PM-PRANAM incentives. Incentives are primarily calculated at state/district level, NOT purely individual. Returns incentive_status ('not_eligible', 'eligible', 'calculated', 'allocated'). Requires session_token. Does NOT claim or disburse incentives — benefits may be indirect. Fails if farmer is not compliant, no reduction in urea usage, or state has not participated.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
